scope: Independent saved-display-pixels-only review of the eight supplied Exercise 7 desktop/mobile focused answer and choice viewport captures for items 4 and 11.
approvalScope: PASS means no revision-requiring clipping, wrapping, overlap, readability, or figure-framing defect was established in the visible saved pixels at the supplied resolutions. It is not approval of unseen content or interactive behavior.
method: Each complete absolute image path was opened exactly once using view_image. Only the original saved viewport pixels were inspected, without zoom, crops, derived images, browser, native app, or rendering.
excludedReviews: The separate existing PASS was not re-reviewed.
limits: Static views cannot certify scrolling, touch interaction, keyboard behavior, focus handling, accessibility, or assistive-technology output.
Covered content and content below or above the supplied viewport cannot be certified; viewport-boundary truncation alone does not establish a broken container or inaccessible continuation.
Fine glyph fidelity, exact subscript/superscript shapes, and character-level mathematical correctness cannot be certified at this single unzoomed view.
No DOM, source, network, database, paid service, or additional evidence was inspected. Input byte counts and hashes are preserved manifest metadata, not independently verified file-integrity results.
The pass applies to these supplied 1440 by 960 desktop and 390 by 844 mobile captures only, not other widths, states, or pages.
